english.title: Make or possess environmental permit document with intent to deceive
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with intent to deceive,

(A)_[made]_
(B)_[possessed]_

a document so closely resembling a document issued or authorised to be issued or required for a purpose under an environmental permit condition as to be likely to deceive
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(4)(d)(ii) and 39(4) of Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016.
